title: 🕒 2026-10-13 | fix: price Ling 3.1 Flash after its free promotion
author: tomdacatto

gist.summary: Ling 3.1 Flash changes from Quest + Paid access to Paid only following the end of its free promotion on 2026-10-13 at 16:00 UTC. Input, cached-input, and output usage is priced per million tokens. Novita remains the primary provider; the OpenRouter→Novita fallback was removed, leaving Vercel→Novita. Text, streaming, tools, and model capabilities are unchanged. The primary and forced fallback routes, paid-only gate, and cache-hit wallet billing were verified. Vercel still lists the model as free, so fallback costing uses Novita's rate; both routes have encountered Novita capacity 429s.
